#### Stern (Heck)
The rear part of a ship

#### Bow (Bug)
The front of a ship

#### aft (achtern)
At, near, or towards the stern

#### Fore/forward ()

#### Forecastle (Vorschiff)
Raised part of the upper deck at the front

#### Quarterdeck (Achterdeck)
The aft part of the upper deck of a ship

#### Mizzen Mast (Besanmast)
- **Ship with 3 masts:** Aftmost mast; third-tallest mast (full-rigged only)
- **Ship with 2 masts:** Second, smaller mast
